entries.scope: Fleet-wide CI profile, local gate, inventory, rollout, cost, security, accessibility and Stage-A operating documentation
entries.rationale: The feature adds user-visible CLI options, machine-readable contracts, a local evidence workflow, security boundaries, cost categories and a non-executed Stage-B handoff. One feature-wide decision keeps navigation, language, platform, distribution and governance evidence reviewable together.
readerPaths: Script reference to gate and evidence
entries.navigationImpact: README links the safe preview to the script reference; manpages, architecture, accessibility and security documents provide progressively deeper operational and assurance detail.
entries.languageStrategy: Integrated German-first, English-second content at approximately CEFR B2; command names and stable machine fields remain unchanged.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Real Bash and PowerShell 7 previews plus PSScriptAnalyzer ran on macOS; common fixtures prove semantic macOS/Linux/Windows normalization without claiming native Linux or Windows execution.
entries.risk: Native Linux and Windows manual output remains a later platform re-evaluation; Stage B and Home sync were not authorized in this run.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Profile, fleet, security, authority, schema, platform, distribution, user-facing output, shared guidance or audience changes.

distributionReview.rationale: The current LocalImplementation authority forbids Home sync; runtime distribution is reviewed but remains unapplied.
